name: PartyTargetWatch
release_type_reason: Version 0.4.0 has offline mock coverage and user-confirmed native %f expansion, addon name receipt and corrected icon/clean-name display. Cross-client delivery, the complete two-line macro and combat/Mythic+ behavior remain unverified.
icon_rights: Original vector artwork created for PartyTargetWatch, distributed under the MIT License; no third-party game, platform, or addon artwork used.
live_verified: User confirmed native focus-name expansion and addon receipt. After reloading the leading-marker fix, the user confirmed both the marker icon and clean monster name display correctly; the rt4 text artifact is gone.
not_live_verified: Version 0.4.0 behavior beyond the locally confirmed focus-name declaration display
Cross-client name declaration receipt, native two-line macro and complete upgrade preservation of saved templates
Multiline declaration editor, cursor scrolling, Chinese input and literal pipe preservation
Draft sample tests, save/cancel boundaries and template persistence
Background-only opacity and transparent background behavior
Target raid markers and scene visibility
compatibility_note: Name declarations are parsed only from already-sent public chat. Native macro %f expansion was user-confirmed locally; secret chat messages are ignored. Names are declared snapshots, not verified real focus, and do not identify individual same-name enemies. Marker-only declarations remain supported without marker-to-monster lookup. Outgoing target calls removed in 0.3.1 remain absent. Optional public focus addon messages are unchanged.
upgrade_note: Existing saved templates are preserved. In /ptw formats use 加入名称格式 to append PTW焦点：%name to the draft, then 保存格式. The release still contains 7 files and no Bindings.xml; preserve WTF SavedVariables.

checks: Changing scale from 100% to 110% and back to 100%
Updating the player's own selected-target name

declaration_template_limits.leading_chat_raid_marker_token: An initial {rt1} through {rt8} in a captured name is extracted as the declaration marker; conflict with explicit %mark rejects the message.

background_opacity.affects: Background, border and row fills only; text and icons remain visible.

current_user_observations: On 2026-09-25 the user confirmed native %f expansion and initial 0.4.0 name receipt/display. The first screenshot exposed a leading rt4 text artifact. After the correction and /reload, the user confirmed normal icon and monster-name display. The marker prefix source was not established; this does not establish arbitrary third-party addon %f support.
